name: io.github.steer-run/steer
title: Steer panel
description: Operate a Steer DevOps panel: instances, servers, deploys, backups, DNS, SSL, VPN and monitoring.

panel_host.description: Host name of your Steer panel (each customer runs their own).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <agent token> created in the panel under Governance → Agent connections. Leave it out to authorize through OAuth 2.1 instead (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Claude Code).

token.description: Agent token (stmcp_…). Optional: the panel is also an OAuth 2.1 authorization server.

authorization.oauth: The panel serves RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata and RFC 8414 authorization-server metadata; clients may register through Client ID Metadata Documents or dynamic client registration, with PKCE S256.
authorization.bearer: Agent tokens created in the panel (masked to the user's permissions).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.rest: https://{panel_host}/api/v1 (same tools and token; OpenAPI at /api/v1/openapi.json)
